_source: gnomAD constraint via GraphQL API https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api
_query: gene(gene_symbol: MYH7, reference_genome: GRCh38){ gnomad_constraint{ pLI oe_lof oe_lof_lower oe_lof_upper lof_z mis_z syn_z oe_mis exp_lof obs_lof } }
_interpretation: pLI ~ 0 and LOEUF (oe_lof_upper) = 0.66 indicate MYH7 is NOT strongly haploinsufficient; observed/expected LoF = 129/225 = 0.57 shows only modest LoF depletion. In contrast mis_z = 7.38 is an extreme missense-constraint signal (>>3.09 threshold). This signature is consistent with pathogenic MYH7 variants acting through altered-function / dominant-negative missense (and in-frame proline) changes rather than loss of protein (haploinsufficiency), which is the genetic premise required by the SRX-energetics model (variants change myosin behavior, not quantity).
